title: Reasons for exchange

blocks.heading: Reasons for exchange
blocks.text: Trade can connect differing resources, skills, products and markets, allowing access beyond domestic production. Benefits depend on viable costs, access and terms; reliance on a narrow product or supplier can expose livelihoods to disruption.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Explain the trade mechanism in this fictional case: a country has surplus fish, a partner needs fish and a suitable cold-chain route exists. Trade can turn surplus into receipts and meet the partner’s demand; the cold chain makes the exchange feasible.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Connect the ideas
blocks.text: Connect to Industrialisation (4.1), Production (3.1) and investment/aid (9.2). Keep transaction type, time period, units and local development criteria explicit. The data is fictional.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
